# Notice

An inline message: the word carries the tone, the icon carries nothing.

In `library/components/notice/` — copy `component.{html,css,js}`, read `docs.md` for why.

**Root:** `.ac-notice`

## ARIA

- **the icon** — `aria-hidden=true`
- **the container it lands in** — `role=status`
- **an error that must interrupt** — `role=alert`
- **the dismiss button, which has no text of its own** — `aria-label`

## Keyboard

- `Enter` — the dismiss button — whose handler owes focus somewhere afterwards

**States:** info, success, warn, error

## Goes wrong when

- role=status on the notice rather than on the container, which was never being watched
- role=alert present at page load, interrupting on every render
- color as the only cue for the tone (SC 1.4.1)
- two buttons both named Close, naming nothing
- the focused dismiss button removed with no answer for where focus goes

## API

- `AC.createNotice(root) -> { build, announce, refresh, destroy }`
- `AC.buildNotice(tone, text)`
- `AC.announceNotice(region, notice)`

WCAG 1.4.1 1.4.11 2.4.3 2.5.8 3.3.1 4.1.3 · [APG](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/alert/) · see also `live-region`, `status-text`, `field`
